Estonia is a three-act sample, not a national corpus: the Constitution, the Riigikogu Election Act and the Personal Data Protection Act are held with accurate in-force history (current Constitution text matches Riigi Teataja line for line, including the 2026-03-01 change to § 156), but none of the five main codes (karistusseadustik, kriminaalmenetluse seadustik, tsiviilkohtumenetluse seadustik, võlaõigusseadus, tsiviilseadustiku üldosa seadus) is in the repository. That is 3 of about 392 laws in force, with no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
